# David McDougall — Executive Producer & Series Director

> Broadcast executive producer, supervising producer and series director with twenty years of broadcast, editorial and branded content experience across four continents, including nine years leading multiplatform production in Doha, Qatar. BBC, Al Jazeera, Channel 4, PBS, Discovery, National Geographic. One-man AI studio delivering broadcast-quality content at speed.
>
> License: CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

## About

War zones. Boardrooms. Milan catwalks and Manila slums. David McDougall has spent twenty years shooting and producing for BBC, Al Jazeera, Channel 4, PBS, Discovery, National Geographic and Qatar Media Corporation — learning what no film school can teach: how to find the real story under pressure, deliver on budget, and hit deadlines that matter.

His first broadcast film, the multi-award-winning investigative documentary Afghan Massacre: The Convoy of Death, exposed the killing of Taliban prisoners by US-allied Northern Alliance forces in Afghanistan and aired on Channel 5, CBC, and ZDF. The Journey, his 15-part dual-language (Arabic/English) travel series for Al Jazeera, reached over 50 million viewers worldwide across the MENA region.

From 2013 to 2022 he ran The Wired Agency as Executive Producer and Founder, generating over £1M in premium branded content and documentary for Qatar Foundation, Harrods, Land Rover, Qatar Airways, Emirates Airlines, Jumeirah and Armani.

In 2023 he closed the agency and went solo. He now runs a one-man film and content studio at the frontier of AI-native production — using Sora, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs and Udio to deliver cinematic-grade video, synthetic voice, sound design and original music at broadcast quality, in days rather than weeks.

He is also the founder of Murmur Labs, an AI product studio building voice-first verification infrastructure. Its flagship product, Murmur.Guide, uses the human voice as its core trust layer.

## Services

- **AI Content Production**: Full-stack AI content production from brief to delivery. Sora, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Udio. Cinematic AI video, synthetic voice, AI music, post production at broadcast quality.
- **Broadcast Documentary**: Investigative and factual documentary direction and production. BBC, Al Jazeera, Channel 4, PBS, Discovery, National Geographic and Qatar Media Corporation credits.
- **Branded Content Production**: Story-led branded films for global brands. Clients include Emirates Airlines, Qatar Airways, Jumeirah, Armani, Harrods, Land Rover, Qatar Foundation and Total.
- **Brand Design & Identity**: Brand identity systems, logo design and visual language. No decoration without purpose.
- **Straplines & Brand Voice**: Brand language, straplines and tone of voice. Investigative instincts applied to commercial copy.
- **AI Workflow Documentation**: Documented AI production workflows, prompt libraries and repeatable processes for cinematic, documentary and brand film outputs.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does David McDougall do?**
David McDougall is an award-winning broadcast executive producer, supervising producer and series director. He produces broadcast documentaries, branded content films and AI-native productions for global brands. He has directed for BBC, Al Jazeera, Channel 4, PBS and Discovery, and produced branded content for Emirates Airlines, Qatar Airways, Jumeirah, Armani and Harrods. He operates as a one-man studio with 20+ years of craft behind the AI tools he uses.

**Has David McDougall worked as an AI Creative Director?**
Yes. David McDougall operates as an AI Creative Director and AI Filmmaker, directing AI-native productions using generative video tools including Sora, Runway ML, and Kling. His AI showreel (https://vimeo.com/1200432945) demonstrates broadcast-quality results produced without a traditional crew — a Nike spec film directed, written and produced solo. He also founded Murmur Labs, an AI product studio specialising in voice-first and aural intelligence applications.

**What AI tools does David McDougall use for video production?**
David McDougall uses Sora, Runway ML, Kling, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Udio, Midjourney, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects to produce broadcast-quality AI content as a one-man studio. He builds and documents repeatable AI production workflows and prompt libraries for cinematic, documentary and brand film outputs, reducing production timelines from weeks to days.

**What documentaries has David McDougall made?**
David McDougall produced the multi-award-winning investigative documentary Afghan Massacre: The Convoy of Death (2002), which exposed the killing of Taliban prisoners by US-allied Northern Alliance forces in Afghanistan. It broadcast on Channel 5 (UK), CBC (Canada), and ZDF (Germany) and won multiple awards. He directed The Journey, a 15-part dual-language (Arabic/English) international travel series for Al Jazeera that reached over 50 million viewers worldwide. He has produced current affairs and factual programming for BBC, Channel 4, PBS, Discovery, National Geographic and Qatar Media Corporation across 40+ countries.

**What makes David McDougall different from a production company?**
You interface directly with the director from brief to final delivery. No account managers, no inflated overhead. Twenty years of craft, frontier AI tools, and the speed that comes from one person who owns every stage of production — from research and scripting through shoot and post.

**Is David McDougall available for commission?**
Yes. Available worldwide for documentary commission, branded content production, AI creative production, brand identity design, strapline writing and creative direction. Based in Richmond, North Yorkshire, UK. Contact: davidmcdougall@proton.me

**What is Murmur Labs?**
Murmur Labs is an AI product studio founded by David McDougall in 2023, building voice-first verification infrastructure. Its flagship product, Murmur.Guide, uses the human voice as its core trust layer — the one thing generative AI still cannot replicate at scale. It combines voice verification with Open Banking transaction data to create unfakeable proof of genuine customer experiences.
